_about: The one list of AETHER scheduled tasks. register_agent_tasks.ps1 registers exactly these under \AETHER_Agents\; the watchdog audits them; the System page shows them. Edit here only. Times are the PROD machine's local time (Pacific). Python tasks run 'venv_new\Scripts\python.exe <script> <args>' through cmd.exe; agent tasks run run_agent.cmd with the prompt. time_limit_min is the Task Scheduler ExecutionTimeLimit.

tasks.name: AETHER_Watchdog
tasks.description: Keeps the E*TRADE and Chaikin sessions alive, audits these scheduled tasks and the logs, checks data freshness and backups, and emails a recovery report when something is wrong. At night it skips the heavy process checks.

tasks.name: AETHER_Morning
tasks.summary: Pre-market pipeline before the 07:00 trade run.
tasks.description: Runs the preflight checks, refreshes Chaikin ratings (main.py), backfills 5 days of history and rebuilds the workbook. It aborts when a preflight check fails.
tasks.notes: Took about 20 min on PROD; run_history and main.py are capped inside it, so 90 min leaves room without letting a hang reach the 07:00 trades.

tasks.name: AETHER_StopMonitor
tasks.summary: Stop-loss monitor every 30 min during the session.
tasks.description: Checks open positions against their stops and targets every 30 minutes from 06:45 to 13:45 and emails when the set of breaches changes.

tasks.name: AETHER_ExecuteTrades
tasks.summary: The trade run at market open.
tasks.description: Deterministic buy/sell run for the AI game: exits (stops, momentum), buys, pyramiding and covered calls. Refuses to trade on a stale workbook. Runs once a day (state lock).

tasks.name: AETHER_DailyDriver
tasks.prompt: Execute the automated skill defined in .claude/commands/daily-run.md
tasks.summary: AI agent: qualitative daily review after the trade run.
tasks.description: Runs the daily-run skill through the CLI agent (run_agent.cmd) for a qualitative review and re-qualification of positions. It does not place trades.

tasks.name: AETHER_PostMarketSync
tasks.prompt: Execute the automated skill defined in .claude/commands/post-market-sync.md
tasks.description: Runs the post-market-sync skill through the CLI agent to refresh ratings and price caches after the close.

tasks.name: AETHER_PostMarketReporter
tasks.prompt: Execute the automated skill defined in .claude/commands/status.md
tasks.description: Runs the status skill through the CLI agent: closing equity, scheduler checks and an error scan.

tasks.name: AETHER_Data_Backup
tasks.summary: The one daily backup of Data/ to the network share.
tasks.description: Robocopy of the local Data folder to the backup share, once a day after the day's data collection. If a collecting script is still running (daily_task and its children, a late pipeline) it waits up to 2 hours, then backs up anyway. Records the result in Data/backup_status.json; exits 1 when the share is offline or the copy fails. No other script syncs Data.
tasks.notes: 22:10, not 22:00: the hourly watchdog starts on the hour and writes under Data/. The evening daily_task usually ends by 19:30 but may run to midnight; the wait covers that. Limit = 120 min wait + 10 min robocopy + headroom.

tasks.name: AETHER_AftermarketReport
tasks.summary: Evening report, then the OHLCV recovery pass.
tasks.description: daily_task: 5-day history backfill, workbook refresh, the evening report email, the Data sync, then the RapidAPI OHLCV recovery pass. Exits 1 and marks the report STEP FAILURE when a step fails.
tasks.notes: The limit must cover daily_task.worst_case_runtime_seconds() (a test checks it).

tasks.name: AETHER_AI_Summary
tasks.description: Emails the AI game's evening summary: equity, positions and the day's trades.

tasks.name: AETHER_PreFlight_Audit
tasks.description: Checks Gmail IMAP/SMTP, Chaikin, E*TRADE, files, locks, the watchdog and these tasks, and emails the result.

tasks.name: AETHER_RD_Scientist
tasks.prompt: Execute the automated R&D skills defined in .claude/commands/pattern-discover.md and .claude/commands/failure-dna.md
tasks.description: Runs the pattern-discover and failure-DNA skills through the CLI agent: missed-winner retro and failure-pattern rules.

tasks.name: AETHER_Chaikin_Reauth
tasks.description: Re-mints the Chaikin PGR session token (about a 7-day JWT) before it lapses, using the persistent Chrome profile, with no human input.
tasks.notes: Runs only when the user is logged on (Interactive principal): headed Chrome needs a desktop; a hidden/S4U session has no display and Turnstile would fail. See plans/chaikin_api.md.

tasks.name: AETHER_Chaikin_Runway_Watch
tasks.description: Checks how long the Chaikin token has left and emails a reminder under 2.5 days. Opens no browser.

tasks.name: AETHER_OptionChainSnapshot
tasks.summary: Daily live option-chain snapshot near the close.
tasks.description: Appends one live E*TRADE option chain per symbol (INTC plus the game's covered-call symbols) to Data/option_chains/<SYM>.jsonl, 25 minutes before the close (15:35 ET). Read-only data client: it never renews a token or opens a browser, and fails loudly if the token is dead. Skips ET weekends and NYSE holidays.
